# 2 Baruch Chapter 87 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** After the eagle had been sent off and flown away, I, Baruch, went to the oak tree of Mamre — the tree beneath which our father Abraham once prayed to the Lord when the angels visited him. And I, Baruch, stayed there.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
